en: The postcard shows an old, sepia-toned photograph of a church building with a pointed steeple. The foreground includes a few trees and two people who appear to be soldiers or locals, indicated by their clothing, standing on a grassy or dirt area. The scene is rural with an air of stillness, likely taken in the early 20th century. At the top, the words 'Juvincourt' and 'Kirche Prouviseux' are printed in red.
